check.notes: The reading is sound. All quotes were found verbatim and support their values, and dataset_size of 3445 correctly sums 1,864 + 863 + 718. I did not challenge three defensible choices: existing_metadata for the Iconclass labels, reported_format_gap 'no' (the three tests are prompting conditions, not answer formats), and 90.45 as the best accuracy (the abstract's 64.86% for Wikidata differs from the table's 66.29%, but the headline figure is unaffected). The reader's key_findings use the table figure.

issues.problem: The reader gives 21, but its own results_explanation admits the figure is 'derived from siglip-base on ICONCLASS Test 1 vs Test 2 comparisons and should be checked', and the cited quote (siglip-large ArtDL 54.45/72.21/53.49) does not yield 21. In Tables 2-4 the largest Test-vs-Test gap for the same model on the same data is siglip-large-patch16-384 on Wikidata: Test 1 60.03% vs Test 2 43.95% = 16.08, and Test 3 61.17% vs Test 2 43.95% = 17.22 (about 17). On ArtDL, clip-vit-base-patch32 Test 1 16.15% vs Test 2 31.55% = 15.4, siglip-base Test 1 48.71% vs Test 2 68.19% = 19.48, siglip-large Test 1 54.45% vs Test 2 72.21% = 17.76, siglip-large Test 2 72.21% vs Test 3 53.49% = 18.72, and siglip-base Test 2 vs Test 3 = 12.29. On ICONCLASS, gpt-4o-mini Test 1 55.74% vs Test 2 59.56% is small. The maximum is siglip-base on ArtDL Test 2 vs Test 1 (19.48, about 19) or siglip-large Test 2 vs Test 3 (18.72); no pair reaches 21. Also, Tests 1-3 are conditions (labels / descriptions / few-shot), not strictly answer formats, so the qualifying status of this comparison is debatable.
issues.instruction: Recompute the largest gap from Tables 2-4 (the maximum appears to be about 19 points: siglip-base-patch16-512 on ArtDL, 48.71% to 68.19%), set reported_format_gap_points accordingly, and align the quote and results_explanation. Remove the contradictory, hedged wording in results_explanation. Also reconsider whether the Test 1/2/3 comparison qualifies as a format or difficulty-regime gap under the definition; if it does not, set reported_format_gap to 'no' and the points to null.
